subject.title: Telegram forum: no reliable topic-name -> topic_id resolution for agent routing

question: Which Telegram agent-facing surface should own known forum topic-name to topic_id resolution for routing?
rationale: Current code has an id-to-name cache, but exposing the reverse route requires maintainer intent for ambiguity, freshness, permissions, and whether this belongs in message actions, session context, or a metadata endpoint.

options.title: Expose Observed Topic Catalog
options.body: Add a Telegram-owned list/catalog action returning known topic ids, names, closed state, and freshness so agents can choose or ask when ambiguous.

options.title: Add Resolver-Only Helper
options.body: Add a direct name-to-id resolver that returns structured ambiguity or stale-cache errors instead of silently routing.

options.title: Keep Numeric IDs
options.body: Leave numeric topic ids as the only routing contract and document the manual-map workaround until maintainers want a stronger surface.

recommendation.title: Expose Observed Topic Catalog
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram-owned list/catalog action returning known topic ids, names, closed state, and freshness so agents can choose or ask when ambiguous.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent topic-cache persistence and Telegram action-surface work is closest to the likely resolver or catalog implementation boundary.
